channel.title: KPFK - Perspectiva de Las Americas
channel.description: Perspectiva de Las Américas is a dynamic, 60-minute weekly radio magazine broadcast Monday nights on KPFK 90.7 FM that explores the rich landscape of Latin American politics, art, and grassroots activism. Blending sharp geopolitical analysis with compelling audio biographies of influential visionaries, the program connects major international currents directly to the struggles and triumphs of Southern California’s immigrant communities. From hyper-local community updates in neighborhoods like Boyle Heights to socially conscious music selections, this Spanish-language broadcast serves as an essential analytical and cultural bridge for the Americas.
